overview: Used for pre-test inspection, locating patterned regions, checking metal-transducer continuity, documenting surface defects, and aligning samples. It is a support tool and does not independently quantify thermal properties.
overviewZh: 用于测试前检查、图形区域定位、金属传感层连续性检查、表面缺陷记录以及样品对准。该设备属于辅助工具，不独立给出热物性参数。
principle: An objective collects light reflected by the sample; the imaging optics form a magnified image at the eyepiece or camera. Illumination and sample optical properties produce contrast. Resolution is limited by wavelength and numerical aperture; quantitative dimensions require a calibrated image scale.
principleZh: 物镜收集样品反射光，由成像光学系统在目镜或相机上形成放大图像。照明方式与样品光学性质产生对比度，分辨率受波长与数值孔径限制；定量尺寸测量需要标定图像比例。
